service.description: Retrieves the General Journal (Libro Giornale) data for an organization and fiscal period or date range. Orders transactions chronologically and calculates running totals (Dare/Avere), page splits, and carry-overs.
Finalizes the General Journal for a period: assigns atomic sequential numbers to transactions via SequenceValueItem and logs the page counts and totals in FiscalRegisterLog.
